    "Verify that the system assigns a technician whose skills match the job requirements.",
    "Simulate the technician accepting the assignment and starting travel to the job site.",
    "Record the time when the technician arrives at the job site.",
    "Simulate the technician completing the required formalities (e.g., safety briefing, paperwork).",
    "Simulate the technician performing the actual work required to close the job.",
    "Record the time when the job is marked as closed/completed.",
    "Compare the total elapsed time from assignment to closure against the specified SLA time.",
    "Check the system logs for any SLA breach alerts or escalations if the time exceeded the limit."

    "System is initialized with at least two technicians available for scheduling.",
    "Technicians have defined profiles including skillset, current location, and mode of transport (e.g., car, bicycle, public transit).",

    "The scheduling engine is operational and can access technician availability and travel time calculations.",
    "No existing assignments conflict with the new task's time window."

  "steps": [
